Rules in, then the speed back

A 0.x.0 release (shaded) adds rules and a new key: accuracy goes up and a parse does a little more work (0.5.0 +10%, 0.6.0 +6%). The point release after it wins the time back without changing a key. 0.4.0 also carried a speed change of its own, so it got faster.
